chess_rating_fide.label: FIDE chess rating (standard)
chess_rating_fide.definition: A player's FIDE Standard (classical time control) Elo rating as published on the monthly FIDE rating list, among all players holding a published rating.
phrasings: what chess rating is the top 1%
what elo is top 1 percent of chess players
how good is a 2000 chess rating
what chess rating puts you in the top 1 percent
average chess rating of rated players

iq_score.label: IQ score
iq_score.base_noun: people who take a standardised IQ test
iq_score.definition: Full-scale score on a supervised, individually administered intelligence test such as the Wechsler Adult Intelligence Scale or Stanford-Binet 5, scaled to a mean of 100 and a standard deviation of 15 against the test's same-age standardization sample.
phrasings: what IQ score is the top 1%
what IQ do you need to be in the top 1 percent
how rare is an IQ of 140
what IQ do you need for Mensa
